product.title: Grand Canyon Sunset Hiking Adventure Deep Below The South Rim

description.text: Hike below the rim in the late afternoon with a private guide timed to watch sunset colors spread across the canyon walls. The route uses South Kaibab or Bright Angel Trail switchbacks with a return climb before dark, starting from Grand Canyon Village area trailheads.

highlights: Private sunset-timed hike below the South Rim
Certified guide paces the route for safe rim return
South Kaibab or Bright Angel Trail options
Golden-hour views across layered canyon walls
Pickup from Tusayan and Grand Canyon Village hotels

start.description: Afternoon meetup at Grand Canyon Village trailhead or hotel pickup in Tusayan. Start time shifts seasonally for optimal sunset timing.

end.description: Return to the South Rim trailhead or your hotel after the post-sunset climb.

product.itinerarySummary: Hike below the rim in the late afternoon with a private guide timed to watch sunset colors spread across the canyon walls.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon South Rim
itineraryItems.description: Gather at the rim for a pre-hike briefing and sunset timing overview.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon Village
itineraryItems.description: Depart from the village area toward the selected below-rim trailhead.

itineraryItems.title: South Kaibab Trail
itineraryItems.description: Descend South Kaibab Trail to a viewpoint positioned for sunset over the inner canyon.

itineraryItems.title: Bright Angel Trail
itineraryItems.description: Alternative descent on Bright Angel Trail with rest at Indian Garden or mile-and-a-half resthouse.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
